Reproduced on the round-4 candidate 53f5d176: QA5-R211a (gate record edited and committed after the auditor's run), R211b (gate record absent from the auditor run's outputs) and R211c (in the run window but not tool-authored) are each accepted with 'validator accepted an invalid gate (no errors)'. My new QA5-N59, a gate record whose bytes come from another role's run, is rejected too. The project test 'F-DG0-121 / F-DG0-211' passes.

Fix ebc8fb7e: findManifest recomputes each round manifest from its source_commit, and checkInvocation requires the run's head_commit_at_start to contain the round manifest. Reproduced on 53f5d176: QA5-R212a (the QA4-N30b attack: a fabricated, backdated manifest plus a genuine pre-freeze run) and R212b (a new variant: an honest-content manifest with a narrowed spec, so a new path, backdated) are both accepted. On the round-5 candidate, R212a is rejected with 'does not describe its source_commit' and 'started from ..., which does not contain docs/delivery/candidates/DG0/...'. R212b is rejected by the start-commit containment rule. N52/N53 (bogus or missing head_commit_at_start) and N57 (non-existent source_commit) are rejected. Informational probe QA5-P01: a round manifest may use a spec narrower than the stage candidate_spec, provided a genuine run started after it was committed. No stated rule requires spec equality for round manifests, and the run-ordering binding holds, so I do not raise it.
